title: Trailer for my TD game made with AI
author: The_Grey_Archive
selftext:
Greetings everyone!

  
A couple weeks ago I was here asking for UI feedback. I took that feedback and made a new UI for the book view, then developed a new UI that people can unlock in game as well.

This week I am here with the first trailer for my game. This is still a rough cut and I can see about 10 things already i want to change, but I think its ready for feedback from the public.

For the game I am making the lore, stories and music videos will be stored on You Tube, with specific cinematics in game.

This trailer has a bit of lore, gameplay looks, etc. The game is still 6 months at least before playtesting can begin, so rip it to shreds. 

100% AI made.

  
[https://youtu.be/JYsl8HSif6M](https://youtu.be/JYsl8HSif6M)

comments.author: ZerkyXii
comments.body: Looks like one of the mobile games off the rip, if its the average person they are out.

comments.author: jmp1103
comments.body: I'll give an honest opinion, the graphic style used is exactly the generic ai slop style. Personally i would probably try to do an other style that stand out and is nore original. Also i watched a little bit and I think you would gain a a looking at some pacing, you have some moments where the narrator don't talk and there is nothing happening in the gameplay - or barely.

replies.author: The_Grey_Archive
replies.body: Yes there are 2 dead air moments with just music, thats one of the 10 things i want to change already. Thanks for the feedback.

comments.author: rrcecil
comments.body:
Yeah the gameplay itself is fine but if you really want this to succeed you either need to figure out a better art and sound pipeline. Between the art and the narrator this is giving really bad slop vibes. Like you need to go asset by asset and set some rules/guardrails if it’s 100% AI and lose the narrator.

I would say this trailer is a wash, the game isn’t ready for a trailer.

replies.author: The_Grey_Archive
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. Your comments confuse me a bit. You said that the game play is fine, but the game isnt ready for a trailer. Is the trailer the issue or the game? I agree on the art being the weakest part at the moment, but do you mean model art or illustrations or both?
